set.body:
Owner decision 2026-09-22: 'stories alone' in 1.0 = offline, deterministic text -> segmented source (no hosted API), usable as a mapping source and exportable; the full narrative StoryModel remains the storyBuild route (hosted LLM or replayed recordings) with its tabular export bd-01M19XMQN4VK4WSTVSHBD3X1YB and real-text validation bd-01M35JHB8QV2A8T2WJY4EVR0A2.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Plain UTF-8 (and the existing surface-atlas/v1 input) -> a checked source package of sentence/clause/paragraph segments with exact character offsets and stable content-addressed ids; the segmentation profile is named and versioned; no network.
2. The same package is accepted by the facade bd-01M2TADC4VKSDZ2S9SXETH2MYM as a mapping source (character/ordinal axis; no encoding-seconds capability unless a presentation schedule is supplied) and by prepare bd-01M35B05TC6GBED9Z3HZMX618E.
3. Round-trip and exchange export (segments table with offsets) readable by the independent Python/R reader.
4. Unicode edge cases (combining marks, CRLF, BOM, surrogate pairs) keep offsets exact; falsifiers mutation-checked.
5. If a StoryModel is supplied (storyBuild output), its narrative units can be used as the mapping targets instead; absence is an explicit capability, not an error.

Evidence: exact SHA, bound test totals/exit, SD6 cold review.
set.title: [Workflow] Offline story ingestion: text to a deterministic segmented source with exact offsets
